blocks.translation: Subject: Tie-in points to the existing collection network for the Wadi Al-Sirhan Independent Sewage Treatment Plant

numerals.meaning: tender reference (Latin script run inside Arabic text)
Table 1-3 (the cover text on page 4 calls it Table 1-3)

lines.source: جدول ١-٣: نقاط الربط وشروط إيقاف التدفق

blocks.translation: Table 1-3: Tie-in points and flow shutdown conditions

lines.source: تُحدِّد نقاط الربط بشبكة التجميع القائمة وشروط إيقاف التدفق فيها على النحو الآتي:

blocks.translation: The tie-in points to the existing collection network and the conditions for shutting down flow in them are specified as follows:

uncertain: band 15 left also holds a handwritten signature stroke under the title (not text); band 15 right holds only an empty circular stamp outline with no legible text

lines.source: FICTIONAL DOCUMENT - Lamar Holding internal assessment pack - not a real tender.

reading.method: Visual reading of the embedded image at native resolution (1750x1550 px). No OCR. Text bands and left/right splits measured from pixels by tenderpack.regions.text_bands; band crops viewed enlarged.

lines.source: ١. لا يُسمح بأي إيقاف خلال شهر رمضان المبارك أو خلال إجازتَي عيد الفطر وعيد الأضحى.

notes.translation: 1. No shutdown is permitted during the holy month of Ramadan or during the Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha holidays.

lines.source: ٢. يُسمح بإيقافٍ واحدٍ فقط لكل نقطة ربط طوال مدّة الإنشاء.

notes.translation: 2. Only one shutdown is permitted for each tie-in point throughout the construction period.

lines.source: ٣. تُقدَّم طلبات الإيقاف عبر البوابة الإلكترونية للشركة، مرفقاً بها برنامج الإيقاف المقترح وخطة الطوارئ.

notes.translation: 3. Shutdown requests are submitted through the Company's electronic portal, accompanied by the proposed shutdown programme and the emergency plan.
4. All times stated are Riyadh time.

reading.method: Visual reading of the embedded image at native resolution (1750x1550 px). No OCR. Text bands and left/right splits measured from pixels by tenderpack.regions.text_bands; band crops viewed enlarged. The ruled table (heading row + 2 data rows x 6 columns, read right to left) is recorded as blocks, one block per cell, each line naming the band and half it lies in, because the pixel grid detector's 4 x 3 grid does not match the printed table.
reading.title: Table 1-3 (image, Arabic with English labels): Tie-in Points and Flow Shutdown Conditions, Network Operator letter No. 312/2026
uncertainties: The pixel grid detector reports a 4 x 3 grid (h_lines 187-898, v_lines 555-1493.5) that does not match the image: the printed table is a heading row and 2 data rows by 6 columns (y ~490-898), read right to left, with the outer and first verticals not detected. A reading as a 6-column table was rejected by RD3, so the table is recorded as one block per cell; columns right to left: tie-in point, location, existing line diameter (mm), permitted shutdown window, maximum shutdown duration (hours), advance notice.
Order of the table cells within a band half follows the printed columns right to left.
Diacritics (damma/shadda/fatha on تُحدِّد, يُسمح, تُقدَّم, مدّة, إجازتَي; tanween on بإيقافٍ واحدٍ, مرفقاً) were checked on enlarged band crops; matching text removes tashkeel.
The letter is stated in the page's text layer to be reproduced from the Network Operator; this reading says only what the image shows.
